Match the reference precisely in subdued antique gold, near-black navy lacquer, thin carved details and warm subdued light. Create ONLY the blank slim emerald Retry button from the reference. Naturally very wide shallow button with visible silhouette width:height approximately6:1, horizontally centered on this larger transparent canvas. Dark controlled emerald faceted enamel center, thin subdued antique-gold double bevel and small angular leaf-like gold end caps; fine small centered gold accents at top and bottom, NO large sapphires, NO big curly ornaments. Match the reference button contour exactly; the center remains dark emerald, not neon green. Broad empty face for live text. Do not fill the canvas vertically: retain transparent margins above and below the slim button. True transparent alpha outside the complete object; preserve fully opaque interior surfaces. No checkerboard, no background scenery, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no extra items. Leave a small clear margin so all ornament tips are visible.
